messages.text: What can I do to get a refund while it’s still on the way?

This refund process can’t refund an order while it’s still on the way; it only covers delivered orders. Cancelling or changing delivery is outside this process, so you can ask a staff member about those options (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders; refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
